governanceRule: Under all failure conditions, NO PCBI is generated, status is set to BLOCKED, and admin action is mandated.

tests.testedCondition: Series has zero observation points in catalog
tests.adminActionRequired: Upload historical observation feed from verified publisher

tests.testedCondition: Available history is 42 months (less than required 75 months)
tests.adminActionRequired: Obtain missing early baseline periods (2020-04 to 2022-12)

tests.testedCondition: Grade mismatch between customer spec (SS316L) and feed (SS304)
tests.adminActionRequired: Select feed strictly matching high-moly marine grade specification

tests.testedCondition: Hydraulic oil specification matched against automotive engine oil
tests.adminActionRequired: Reject automotive oil feed; procure ISO VG 46 industrial hydraulic series

tests.testedCondition: Feed reported in Japanese Yen without approved FX conversion rule
tests.adminActionRequired: Establish approved RBI/BOJ daily settlement FX rate rule

tests.testedCondition: Feed measured in Short Tons (2000 lbs) without conversion formula
Customer purchase in India matched to Brazilian domestic FOB mill
tests.adminActionRequired: Require domestic Indian or CFR Nhava Sheva landed benchmark

tests.testedCondition: Fortnightly feed mapped to weekly cycle using synthetic interpolation
tests.adminActionRequired: Obtain methodology approval before performing interpolation
Re-ingest source document with cryptographically verified checksum

tests.testedCondition: Turnings scrap series attempting automatic -18% price formula
tests.adminActionRequired: Submit methodology derivation to administrator for governance approval
